name: Parloa
description: Parloa is an enterprise AI agent management platform for contact centers — voice and chat workflows, deep CRM/ticketing integrations, and conversation analytics. Series D in January 2026 raised $350M at a $3B valuation; >$50M ARR with 150% NRR.
